# Conditional strategy connections

Source-backed draft interactions, grouped by guide family. Conditions, source era and uncertainty still apply. [Wiki](README.md) · [Guide collection](FACTION_SUMMARIES.md) · [Components and backlinks](components.md)

## The Arborec

[Integrated page](factions/arborec.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/arborec-strategy-summary.md)

- [Mitosis](components.md#ability-mitosis) **enables** [Letani Warrior I](components.md#unit-arborec-infantry). Mitosis supplies one infantry to a planet Arborec controls each status phase; space docks still cannot produce infantry. Sources: [SCPT 454, 1437.68–1519.08s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/454-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-arborec/)
- [Letani Warrior I](components.md#unit-arborec-infantry) **synergizes-with** [X-89 Bacterial Weapon Ω](components.md#technology-x89). X-89 is presented as a way to win major ground combats with concentrated infantry, especially at Mecatol or Styx; tech access depends on skips and timing. Sources: [SCPT 454, 6323.38–6392.26s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/454-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-arborec/)
- [Letani Behemoth](components.md#unit-arborec-mech) **synergizes-with** [Letani Warrior I](components.md#unit-arborec-infantry). Deploying a mech removes infantry; once present, its production and planetary shield complement the remaining ground force. Sources: [SCPT 454, 1827.18–1858.08s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/454-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-arborec/)
- [Letani Warrior II](components.md#technology-lw2) **conflicts-with** [X-89 Bacterial Weapon Ω](components.md#technology-x89). When choosing between the next research targets with a suitable skip, the hosts prefer X-89 over Letani Warrior II; this is a situational path tradeoff. Sources: [SCPT 454, 2456.90–2511.10s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/454-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-arborec/)
- [Stymie](components.md#promissory-stymie) **counters** [The Arborec](factions/arborec.md). The holder may use Stymie after ships enter a system containing Arborec units to place a command token in a non-home system, disrupting the position; the note can be used against its owner. Sources: [SCPT 454, 2045.30–2114.66s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/454-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-arborec/)

## The Ghosts of Creuss

[Integrated page](factions/ghost.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/ghost-strategy-summary.md)

- [Emissary Taivra](components.md#leader-ghostagent) **enables** [The Ghosts of Creuss](factions/ghost.md). At the start of round one, the hosts use the agent to make home and Malice adjacent for a tactical action, enabling the commonly described Malice opening. Sources: [SCPT 326, 2076.22–2189.66s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/326-super-ghosts-of-creuss-guide/)
- [Carrier II](components.md#technology-cv2) **synergizes-with** [Sai Seravus](components.md#leader-ghostcommander). Carrier II capacity and movement help eligible ships move through wormholes and retain unused capacity for the commander’s fighter placement. Sources: [SCPT 326, 2324.36–2449.74s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/326-super-ghosts-of-creuss-guide/)
- [Wormhole Generator](components.md#technology-wg) **enables** [Slipstream](components.md#ability-slipstream). Moving a Creuss wormhole token to a useful origin can provide a system from which Ghost ships gain Slipstream movement; this is one optional late-game use discussed by the hosts. Sources: [SCPT 326, 3155.44–3169.36s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/326-super-ghosts-of-creuss-guide/)
- [Fleet Logistics](components.md#technology-fl) **synergizes-with** [Riftwalker Meian](components.md#leader-ghosthero). The speakers describe Fleet Logistics as useful for acting immediately after the hero’s system swap, allowing a follow-up action before opponents respond. Sources: [SCPT 326, 5833.44–5895.94s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/326-super-ghosts-of-creuss-guide/)
- [Creuss Iff](components.md#promissory-iff) **enables** [Sai Seravus](components.md#leader-ghostcommander). Placing alpha/beta wormholes with a cooperative partner can help reach the commander’s three-system unlock condition; the guide proposes a reciprocal Alliance arrangement. Sources: [SCPT 326, 2472.10–2535.22s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/326-super-ghosts-of-creuss-guide/)
- [Creuss Iff](components.md#promissory-iff) **conflicts-with** [Icarus Drive](components.md#unit-ghost-mech). A buyer may distrust the IFF if Ghosts retain mechs that can later remove wormhole tokens; the hosts recommend building trust and treating mech relocation as occasional. Sources: [SCPT 326, 1763.52–1807.62s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/326-super-ghosts-of-creuss-guide/)

## The Emirates of Hacan

[Integrated page](factions/hacan.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/hacan-strategy-summary.md)

- [Guild Ships](components.md#ability-guild-ships) **synergizes-with** [Arbiters](components.md#ability-arbiters). When Hacan transacts across the table and offers action cards during deals. Sources: [SCPT 360, 865.37–905.37s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/360-super-emirates-of-hacan-guide/)
- [Pride of Kenara](components.md#unit-hacan-mech) **enables** [Construction](components.md#strategy-card-pok4construction). A forward dock is on a planet Hacan can trade and the mech can move structures to a controlled destination. Sources: [SCPT 360, 2802.07–2895.15s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/360-super-emirates-of-hacan-guide/)
- [Trade](components.md#strategy-card-pok5trade) **enables** [Gila the Silvertongue](components.md#leader-hacancommander). Trade briefly puts ten goods on Hacan before transfer. Sources: [SCPT 360, 1676.94–1734.10s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/360-super-emirates-of-hacan-guide/)
- [Quantum Datahub Node](components.md#technology-qdn) **enables** [Imperial](components.md#strategy-card-pok8imperial). QDN exchanges a card at strategy-phase end, supporting later Imperial access when available. Sources: [SCPT 360, 3500.96–3528.56s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/360-super-emirates-of-hacan-guide/)
- [Trade Convoys](components.md#promissory-convoys) **synergizes-with** [Guild Ships](components.md#ability-guild-ships). Trade Convoys gives its holder non-neighbor transaction access alongside Hacan’s own ability. Sources: [SCPT 360, 1092.25–1188.35s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/360-super-emirates-of-hacan-guide/)

## The Universities of Jol-Nar

[Integrated page](factions/jolnar.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/jolnar-strategy-summary.md)

- [E-Res Siphons](components.md#technology-ers) **synergizes-with** [Research Agreement](components.md#promissory-ra). Bargaining and income tools; neither guarantees the other triggers. Sources: [SCPT 340, 1279.90–1403.16s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/340-super-universities-of-jol-nar-strategy-guide/); [SCPT 340, 1436.62–1474.24s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/340-super-universities-of-jol-nar-strategy-guide/)
- [Brilliant](components.md#ability-brilliant) **enables** [Technology](components.md#strategy-card-pok7technology). Following Technology secondary may resolve primary via Brilliant, subject to conditions. Sources: [SCPT 340, 1071.28–1090.14s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/340-super-universities-of-jol-nar-strategy-guide/)
- [PDS II](components.md#technology-pds2) **enables** [PDS I](components.md#unit-pds). When researched and defensive placement matters. Sources: [SCPT 340, 4336.80–4367.78s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/340-super-universities-of-jol-nar-strategy-guide/)
- [Dreadnought II](components.md#technology-dn2) **synergizes-with** [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd). - [Sling Relay](components.md#technology-sr) **synergizes-with** [Bio-Stims](components.md#technology-bs). Bio-Stims may refresh Sling Relay for a stall/action line. Sources: [SCPT 340, 5638.28–5659.14s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/340-super-universities-of-jol-nar-strategy-guide/)

## The L1Z1X Mindnet

[Integrated page](factions/l1z1x.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/l1z1x-strategy-summary.md)

- [Super Dreadnought I](components.md#unit-l1z1x-dreadnought) **synergizes-with** [Harrow](components.md#ability-harrow). Harrow applies bombardment after each ground-combat round when the dreadnought is in the active system. Sources: [SCPT 347, 1748.08–1829.52s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/347-super-l1z1x-mindnet-guide/)
- [Assimilate](components.md#ability-assimilate) **enables** [Space Dock I](components.md#unit-spacedock). Taking a planet with an enemy space dock can replace it with L1’s dock before tactical-action production. Sources: [SCPT 347, 1704.50–1730.54s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/347-super-l1z1x-mindnet-guide/)
- [\[0.0.1\]](components.md#unit-l1z1x-flagship) **synergizes-with** [Super Dreadnought I](components.md#unit-l1z1x-dreadnought). Flagship and dreadnought hits in its system are assigned to non-fighter ships when able. Sources: [SCPT 347, 1866.74–1904.40s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/347-super-l1z1x-mindnet-guide/)
- [The Helmsman](components.md#leader-l1z1xhero) **enables** [\[0.0.1\]](components.md#unit-l1z1x-flagship). Helmsman can move the flagship and dreadnoughts to a system without other players’ ships. Sources: [SCPT 347, 2863.54–2937.82s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/347-super-l1z1x-mindnet-guide/)
- [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd) **synergizes-with** [The Helmsman](components.md#leader-l1z1xhero). Gravity Drive is prioritized partly for flagship movement and late-game mobility. Sources: [SCPT 347, 4700.26–4740.66s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/347-super-l1z1x-mindnet-guide/)
- [Super Dreadnought II](components.md#technology-sdn2) **enables** [Super Dreadnought II](components.md#unit-l1z1x-dreadnought2). The guide treats Super Dreadnought II as a core upgrade for dreadnought reach and combat. Sources: [SCPT 347, 4700.26–4740.66s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/347-super-l1z1x-mindnet-guide/)

## The Barony of Letnev

[Integrated page](factions/letnev.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/letnev-strategy-summary.md)

- [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd) **synergizes-with** [Destroyer II](components.md#unit-destroyer2). Gravity Drive or another movement boost raises the fast escort&#x27;s value, allowing Graveliche to carry slower ships that began with it. Sources: [SCPT 463, 3163.14–3251.84s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/)
- [Non-Euclidean Shielding](components.md#technology-nes) **synergizes-with** [Arc Secundus](components.md#unit-letnev-flagship). Non-Euclidean Shielding improves the value of the flagship&#x27;s sustain when it is exposed to hits; the flagship also repairs itself at the start of each combat round. Sources: [SCPT 463, 2242.44–2332.56s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/); [SCPT 463, 2877.81–2944.09s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/)
- [Non-Euclidean Shielding](components.md#technology-nes) **synergizes-with** [Rear Admiral Farran](components.md#leader-letnevcommander). When a unit sustains damage, commander income may be generated; repeated sustain-and-repair ideas depend on enough resources and a combat that can end. Sources: [SCPT 463, 4477.60–4525.94s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/); [SCPT 463, 4552.78–4615.62s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/); [SCPT 463, 4761.64–4840.94s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/)
- [The Cavalry](components.md#promissory-cavalry) **synergizes-with** [Non-Euclidean Shielding](components.md#technology-nes). If Cavalry grants a Barony unit Sustain Damage, Non-Euclidean Shielding increases its hit-cancellation value; negotiate a price that both players accept. Sources: [SCPT 463, 2877.81–2944.09s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/); [SCPT 463, 8349.32–8399.24s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/)
- [Viscount Unlenn](components.md#leader-letnevagent) **synergizes-with** [Destroyer II](components.md#unit-destroyer2). In a combat where Barony fields the Destroyer II fleet, choose the agent&#x27;s extra die for the ship with the best post-Graveliche hit chance. Sources: [SCPT 463, 4276.70–4368.14s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/); [SCPT 463, 7436.86–7488.58s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/)
- [Scepter of Emelpar](components.md#relic-emelpar) **enables** [The Barony of Letnev](factions/letnev.md). If reachable and available, its resource refresh can reimburse early breakthrough spending, preserving resources for a later build or research. Sources: [SCPT 463, 3816.12–3898.78s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/)
- [The Crimson Rebellion](factions/crimson.md) **counters** [The Barony of Letnev](factions/letnev.md). The matchup is especially difficult if Crimson&#x27;s flagship can suppress the sustain plan at the contested Mecatol Rex or Styx system. Sources: [SCPT 463, 5657.94–5721.28s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/); [SCPT 463, 9033.66–9091.96s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/)
- [The Mentak Coalition](factions/mentak.md) **counters** [Rear Admiral Farran](components.md#leader-letnevcommander). Pillage can intercept the commander&#x27;s one-trade-good-at-a-time income when Mentak is able and willing to trigger it. Sources: [SCPT 463, 4653.42–4721.66s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/)
- [Military Support](components.md#promissory-ms) **enables** [Dunlain Reaper](components.md#unit-letnev-mech). Trading for Sol&#x27;s Military Support can help Barony replenish infantry for ground defense and Dunlane Reaper replacements. Sources: [SCPT 463, 8078.56–8149.08s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/); [SCPT 463, 8149.08–8196.96s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/463-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-barony-of-letnev/)

## The Mentak Coalition

[Integrated page](factions/mentak.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/mentak-strategy-summary.md)

- [Psychoarchaeology](components.md#technology-pa) **synergizes-with** [Mirror Computing](components.md#technology-mc). When both technologies are researched and Mentak have a planet they can exhaust for a trade good. Sources: [SCPT 344, 5345.41–5448.40s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/344-super-mentak-coalition-guide/)
- [Pillage](components.md#ability-pillage) **enables** [Suffi An](components.md#leader-mentakagent). After Mentak use Pillage against another player; Suffi An may be exhausted for both players to draw an action card. Sources: [SCPT 344, 2919.38–2942.56s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/344-super-mentak-coalition-guide/); [SCPT 344, 7139.06–7199.24s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/344-super-mentak-coalition-guide/)
- [War Sun](components.md#technology-ws) **synergizes-with** [Ipswitch, Loose Cannon](components.md#leader-mentakhero). If Mentak can afford, build, and move a War Sun into a decisive combat, the hero can magnify the combat’s ship replacement effect. Sources: [SCPT 344, 8273.29–8375.69s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/344-super-mentak-coalition-guide/)
- [Promise of Protection](components.md#promissory-pop) **synergizes-with** [Pillage](components.md#ability-pillage). When a round-one payment for Promise of Protection is worth more to Mentak than the later Pillage income forgone from that player. Sources: [SCPT 344, 7329.06–7498.48s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/344-super-mentak-coalition-guide/); [SCPT 344, 7537.12–7598.90s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/344-super-mentak-coalition-guide/)

## The Embers of Muaat

[Integrated page](factions/muaat.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/muaat-strategy-summary.md)

- [Ember Colossus](components.md#unit-muaat-mech) **enables** [The Embers of Muaat](factions/muaat.md). Mechs placed within Star Forge&#x27;s applicable range add infantry when that faction ability is used. Sources: [SCPT 355, 1105.08–1138.30s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/)
- [Magmus](components.md#leader-muaatcommander) **synergizes-with** [The Embers of Muaat](factions/muaat.md). After its War Sun production unlock, the commander returns trade goods on strategy-pool spending, offsetting repeated Star Forge and other token costs. Sources: [SCPT 355, 1632.85–1702.77s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/)
- [Magmus Reactor](components.md#technology-mr) **synergizes-with** [Adjudicator Ba&#x27;al](components.md#leader-muaathero). Magnus Reactor Omega can make a supernova usable for production; the hero can create a supernova position for later production and staging. Sources: [SCPT 355, 1504.37–1548.65s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/); [SCPT 355, 1812.24–1828.04s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/)
- [Prototype War Sun II](components.md#technology-pws2) **enables** [Prototype War Sun II](components.md#unit-muaat-warsun2). The upgrade improves War Sun movement, opening earlier access across the slice and toward late-game targets. Sources: [SCPT 355, 1406.47–1472.03s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/); [SCPT 355, 3970.42–3990.32s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/)
- [Carrier II](components.md#technology-cv2) **synergizes-with** [Ember Colossus](components.md#unit-muaat-mech). Carrier II helps move the fighter/infantry support generated around Star Forge and lets the fleet travel together in the blue-route example. Sources: [SCPT 355, 4051.72–4078.96s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/); [SCPT 355, 4117.74–4145.52s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/)
- [Umbat](components.md#leader-muaatagent) **enables** [Prototype War Sun II](components.md#unit-muaat-warsun2). Umbat can produce up to two units in a system with a War Sun; the guide values this for converting resources into units, subject to the unit-cost cap and available money. Sources: [SCPT 355, 1548.75–1587.67s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/); [SCPT 355, 2053.30–2096.64s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/)
- [Adjudicator Ba&#x27;al](components.md#leader-muaathero) **enables** [Prototype War Sun II](components.md#unit-muaat-warsun2). The hero&#x27;s Nova Seed trigger requires moving a War Sun to a non-home system other than Mecatol Rex, then can establish the supernova position described in the source. Sources: [SCPT 355, 1748.25–1775.29s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/); [SCPT 355, 4732.18–4754.08s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/)
- [Magmus](components.md#leader-muaatcommander) **synergizes-with** [Umbat](components.md#leader-muaatagent). Both reward the War Sun production engine: Umbat supplies units while the unlocked commander can return a trade good when strategy-pool tokens are spent. Sources: [SCPT 355, 1548.75–1587.67s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/); [SCPT 355, 1644.21–1702.77s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/355-super-embers-of-muaat-guide/)

## The Naalu Collective

[Integrated page](factions/naalu.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/naalu-strategy-summary.md)

- [Z&#x27;eu](components.md#leader-naaluagent) **enables** [Hybrid Crystal Fighter II](components.md#unit-naalu-fighter2). Sources: [SCPT 270, 1141.88–1188.30s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/270-super-naalu-collective-guide/); [SCPT 270, 1197.54–1208.60s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/270-super-naalu-collective-guide/); [SCPT 270, 1227.52–1239.14s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/270-super-naalu-collective-guide/)

- [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd) **enables** [Matriarch](components.md#unit-naalu-flagship). Gravity Drive supports the late Matriarch movement described by the hosts. Sources: [SCPT 270, 1243.26–1277.48s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/270-super-naalu-collective-guide/); [SCPT 270, 4935.90–4941.62s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/270-super-naalu-collective-guide/)
- [Gift of Prescience](components.md#promissory-gift) **conflicts-with** [Telepathic](components.md#ability-telepathic). Gift of Prescience gives its holder first initiative while disabling Telepathic for that round. Sources: [SCPT 270, 1321.96–1337.76s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/270-super-naalu-collective-guide/); [SCPT 270, 1378.10–1390.36s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/270-super-naalu-collective-guide/)

## The Nekro Virus

[Integrated page](factions/nekro.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/nekro-strategy-summary.md)

- [Technological Singularity](components.md#ability-technological-singularity) **enables** [Valefar Assimilator X](components.md#technology-vax). A qualifying combat technology gain can instead place Valefar X on the opponent’s faction technology under the episode’s reading. Sources: [SCPT 323, 1867.28–1886.30s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/)
- [Technological Singularity](components.md#ability-technological-singularity) **enables** [Valefar Assimilator Y](components.md#technology-vay). A qualifying combat technology gain can instead place Valefar Y on the opponent’s faction technology under the episode’s reading. Sources: [SCPT 323, 1867.28–1886.30s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/)
- [The Alastor](components.md#unit-nekro-flagship) **synergizes-with** [Mordred](components.md#unit-nekro-mech). The Alastor can bring ground forces into a space combat and Mordred’s combat value then contributes to that combat; the connection is most relevant to an offensive flagship plan. Sources: [SCPT 323, 2098.08–2165.94s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/); [SCPT 323, 2571.30–2641.00s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/)
- [UNIT.DSGN.FLAYESH](components.md#leader-nekrohero) **enables** [Integrated Economy](components.md#technology-ie). When a yellow specialty is available and the objective/map justify it, the hero can gain a matching-color technology; the speakers discuss Integrated Economy as one conditional target. Sources: [SCPT 323, 2954.50–3043.34s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/); [SCPT 323, 3314.34–3565.10s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/)
- [Nekro Malleon](components.md#leader-nekroagent) **synergizes-with** [Nekro Acidos](components.md#leader-nekrocommander). The agent can create two trade goods when another player accepts its cost; the commander can draw an action card after a later qualifying technology gain, and its draw can support another agent payment only if the card is expendable. Sources: [SCPT 323, 2673.08–2753.68s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/); [SCPT 323, 2753.68–2792.28s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/)
- [Sling Relay](components.md#technology-sr) **enables** [The Alastor](components.md#unit-nekro-flagship). Sling Relay is proposed as a route to a forward dock from which the flagship can act offensively before returning to defend home; this requires the card, timing, and board position. Sources: [SCPT 323, 6970.78–6992.86s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/)
- [Warfare](components.md#strategy-card-pok6warfare) **conflicts-with** [Trade](components.md#strategy-card-pok5trade). In the guide’s round-one priority, taking needed Warfare can mean forgoing the otherwise attractive Trade pick. Sources: [SCPT 323, 4976.02–5000.36s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/)
- [Destroyer II](components.md#technology-dd2) **enables** [Technological Singularity](components.md#ability-technological-singularity). Destroyer II’s Anti-Fighter Barrage can destroy an opponent’s unit during combat, creating a stated opportunity for the combat technology gain. Sources: [SCPT 323, 1590.86–1648.38s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/)
- [Imperial](components.md#strategy-card-pok8imperial) **scores** [The Nekro Virus](factions/nekro.md). The guide recommends an Imperial pick when it can secure a bonus point such as Mecatol Rex, unless doing so diverts too much plastic or creates unacceptable risk. Sources: [SCPT 323, 6331.44–6367.08s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/323-super-nekro-virus-guide/)

## The Clan of Saar

[Integrated page](factions/saar.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/saar-strategy-summary.md)

- [Scavenge](components.md#ability-scavenge) **synergizes-with** [Scavenger Zeta](components.md#unit-saar-mech). After gaining a planet, the Scavenge trade good can be spent for that planet’s mech; the trade good has an opportunity cost. Sources: [SCPT 336, 1402.18–1479.08s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)
- [Chaos Mapping](components.md#technology-cm) **synergizes-with** [Floating Factory I](components.md#unit-saar-spacedock). Chaos Mapping’s start-of-turn production rewards Saar for having a Production unit in useful systems and for researching the technology early. Sources: [SCPT 336, 2076.10–2156.18s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)
- [Chaos Mapping](components.md#technology-cm) **conflicts-with** [Sarween Tools](components.md#technology-st). The guide distinguishes Chaos Mapping’s “produce” effect from the Production ability and says Sarween Tools does not discount this effect. Sources: [SCPT 336, 2223.04–2286.10s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)
- [Chaos Mapping](components.md#technology-cm) **synergizes-with** [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd). Chaos Mapping is the guide’s continuing priority; Gravity Drive is a conditional first pick when it enables custodians or a necessary reach breakpoint. Sources: [SCPT 336, 3576.12–3649.00s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)
- [Chaos Mapping](components.md#technology-cm) **enables** [Carrier II](components.md#technology-cv2). The guide describes Chaos Mapping followed by Carrier II as a viable shallow technology route that adds capacity without requiring Gravity Drive in every game. Sources: [SCPT 336, 3711.90–3894.46s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)
- [Captain Mendosa](components.md#leader-saaragent) **synergizes-with** [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd). The agent’s increased move value combines with Gravity Drive’s later modifier when a movement breakpoint such as custodians matters. Sources: [SCPT 336, 1740.62–1768.80s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)
- [Construction](components.md#strategy-card-pok4construction) **enables** [Floating Factory II](components.md#unit-saar-spacedock2). Construction provides Saar another dock, reducing single-dock vulnerability and progressing the three-dock commander unlock. Sources: [SCPT 336, 2786.66–2843.82s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)
- [Floating Factory I](components.md#unit-saar-spacedock) **requires** [Rowl Sarring](components.md#leader-saarcommander). The commander unlock requires three space docks on the board; routing produced infantry or fighters also requires an unblocked destination dock and remains within production capacity. Sources: [SCPT 336, 1815.76–1902.96s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)
- [Chaos Mapping](components.md#technology-cm) **synergizes-with** [Dark Energy Tap](components.md#technology-det). Chaos Mapping protects Saar’s asteroid-field presence while Dark Energy Tap can provide frontier access and alternative retreat destinations; DET is a later, economy-dependent investment. Sources: [SCPT 336, 2305.46–2348.06s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/); [SCPT 336, 4370.00–4492.20s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)
- [Gurno Aggero](components.md#leader-saarhero) **counters** [Floating Factory I](components.md#unit-saar-spacedock). The hero destroys opposing infantry and fighters in a system adjacent to a Saar dock, offering a late-game answer to units that otherwise absorb Saar’s attacks. Sources: [SCPT 336, 1910.26–2004.54s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)
- [Improve Infrastructure](components.md#public-objective-infrastructure) **conflicts-with** [Floating Factory I](components.md#unit-saar-spacedock). Improve Infrastructure counts structures on planets; a Saar floating factory is in space, so Saar may need PDS or an alternate scoring route. Sources: [SCPT 336, 5173.80–5224.34s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)
- [Imperial](components.md#strategy-card-pok8imperial) **scores** [The Clan of Saar](factions/saar.md). The guide identifies taking Mecatol with Imperial later as a conditional scoring route when Saar needs the point and can meet the card and objective timing. Sources: [SCPT 336, 4545.02–4573.80s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/336-super-clan-of-saar-guide/)

## Sardakk Norr

[Integrated page](factions/sardakk.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/sardakk-strategy-summary.md)

- [G&#x27;hom Sek&#x27;kus](components.md#leader-sardakkcommander) **synergizes-with** [T&#x27;ro](components.md#leader-sardakkagent). T’ro puts infantry on an active front that can support adjacent-system commitment. Sources: [SCPT 379, 1677.56–1718.26s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/); [SCPT 379, 1787.40–1831.16s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/)
- [G&#x27;hom Sek&#x27;kus](components.md#leader-sardakkcommander) **synergizes-with** [Sh&#x27;val, Harbinger](components.md#leader-sardakkhero). Both can threaten ground invasions without relying on winning ordinary space combat; the hero is a more costly, decisive strike. Sources: [SCPT 379, 1889.96–1935.62s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/); [SCPT 379, 2290.32–2308.02s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/)
- [Light/Wave Deflector](components.md#technology-lwd) **enables** [Sh&#x27;val, Harbinger](components.md#leader-sardakkhero). Light/Wave improves the chance Sardakk ships can reach the hero’s chosen active system. Sources: [SCPT 379, 4583.46–4604.52s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/)
- [Sling Relay](components.md#technology-sr) **synergizes-with** [T&#x27;ro](components.md#leader-sardakkagent). Sling Relay supplements home production; T’ro adds infantry at the active front. Sources: [SCPT 379, 4295.06–4331.28s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/); [SCPT 379, 1677.56–1718.26s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/)
- [Valkyrie Exoskeleton](components.md#unit-sardakk-mech) **synergizes-with** [Valkyrie Particle Weave](components.md#technology-vpw). Particle Weave can add a ground-combat hit alongside the mech’s sustain-triggered hit; the guide considers the tech too costly as a default. Sources: [SCPT 379, 2623.72–2635.24s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/); [SCPT 379, 2670.54–2712.70s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/)
- [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd) **synergizes-with** [Carrier II](components.md#technology-cv2). The guide treats both as the core blue movement-and-capacity package; order may vary with skips. Sources: [SCPT 379, 4160.03–4199.97s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/)
- [Exotrireme II](components.md#technology-exo2) **counters** [Carrier I](components.md#unit-carrier). If Exotrireme II survives a combat round, the described ability can remove up to two ships and threaten carrier capacity. Sources: [SCPT 379, 2476.70–2589.18s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/)
- [Fighter II](components.md#technology-ff2) **synergizes-with** [Unrelenting](components.md#ability-unrelenting). The guide likes Fighter II because improved fighters also receive Sardakk’s combat-roll modifier; hit-threshold math is approximate. Sources: [SCPT 379, 4630.96–4660.26s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/379-super-sardakk-norr-guide-the-final-super-guide/)

## The Federation of Sol

[Integrated page](factions/sol.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/sol-strategy-summary.md)

- [Bio-Stims](components.md#technology-bs) **synergizes-with** [Sling Relay](components.md#technology-sr). The guide’s stated interaction is most useful when Sol can create additional start-of-turn windows and has buyers for repeated Military Support offers. Sources: [SCPT 328, 4700.66–4780.18s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/328-super-federation-of-sol-guide/)
- [Predictive Intelligence](components.md#technology-pi) **synergizes-with** [Jace X, 4th Air Legion](components.md#leader-solhero). A planned hero turn can reclaim tokens spread across the board after Sol has used them to stall; the source presents this as a niche line. Sources: [SCPT 328, 4844.58–4908.70s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/328-super-federation-of-sol-guide/)
- [Versatile](components.md#ability-versatile) **synergizes-with** [Leadership](components.md#strategy-card-pok1leadership). The round-one Leadership pick is attractive when Sol can convert the extra tokens into useful actions. Sources: [SCPT 328, 3374.74–3423.40s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/328-super-federation-of-sol-guide/)
- [Evelyn DeLouis](components.md#leader-solagent) **enables** [Spec Ops I](components.md#unit-sol-infantry). The agent’s added die matters most in a consequential ground-combat round with a small number of units. Sources: [SCPT 328, 1837.80–1924.40s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/328-super-federation-of-sol-guide/)
- [Claire Gibson](components.md#leader-solcommander) **enables** [Spec Ops I](components.md#unit-sol-infantry). After the commander unlocks, the added infantry strengthens a controlled planet when ground combat begins. Sources: [SCPT 328, 2069.77–2129.93s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/328-super-federation-of-sol-guide/)
- [Genesis ](components.md#unit-sol-flagship) **synergizes-with** [Spec Ops I](components.md#unit-sol-infantry). The flagship can add a free infantry in its system at status, and its capacity makes transporting ground forces central to Sol’s plan. Sources: [SCPT 328, 1612.18–1707.20s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/328-super-federation-of-sol-guide/)

## The Winnu

[Integrated page](factions/winnu.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/winnu-strategy-summary.md)

- [Berekar Berekon](components.md#leader-winnuagent) **enables** [Reclaimer](components.md#unit-winnu-mech). The agent&#x27;s production discount can help afford an early mech when Winnu needs to place plastic or pursue a structure objective. Sources: [SCPT 352, 2794.00–2813.70s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/352-super-the-winnu-guide/)
- [Rickar Rickani](components.md#leader-winnucommander) **synergizes-with** [Fighter I](components.md#unit-fighter). The commander adds combat strength in its listed systems, while a large fleet gives that bonus more opportunities to matter; the hosts specifically say fighters can become threatening with the bonus and action cards. Sources: [SCPT 352, 1724.13–1734.71s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/352-super-the-winnu-guide/); [SCPT 352, 3141.20–3150.96s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/352-super-the-winnu-guide/)
- [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd) **enables** [Carrier II](components.md#unit-carrier2). The guide&#x27;s stated blue path combines Gravity Drive with Carrier II to improve carrier reach for late-game positioning; it does not claim this pair alone can slay a leader. Sources: [SCPT 352, 3824.10–3888.36s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/352-super-the-winnu-guide/)
- [Mathis Mathinus](components.md#leader-winnuhero) **scores** [Imperial](components.md#strategy-card-pok8imperial). The hero can resolve Imperial&#x27;s primary as a late catch-up action when the objective and Mecatol timing support scoring; the use may trigger a table response. Sources: [SCPT 352, 1982.48–2025.76s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/352-super-the-winnu-guide/); [SCPT 352, 3591.88–3669.54s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/352-super-the-winnu-guide/)
- [Alliance](components.md#promissory-color-an) **conflicts-with** [Rickar Rickani](components.md#leader-winnucommander). Giving Alliance to a Mecatol rival can let that player use Winnu&#x27;s combat bonus against Winnu in the Mecatol Rex system. Sources: [SCPT 352, 3510.58–3534.42s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/352-super-the-winnu-guide/)
- [Fighter I](components.md#unit-fighter) **counters** [Salai Sai Corian](components.md#unit-winnu-flagship). The speakers say opposing heavy fighter screens reduce the Winnu flagship&#x27;s dice because its dice count opposing non-fighter ships. Sources: [SCPT 352, 1091.38–1109.14s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/352-super-the-winnu-guide/)

## The Xxcha Kingdom

[Integrated page](factions/xxcha.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/xxcha-strategy-summary.md)

- [Diplomacy](components.md#strategy-card-pok2diplomacy) **enables** [Peace Accords](components.md#ability-peace-accords). Resolving either Diplomacy primary or secondary is the trigger described in the faction ability; Peace Accords still requires an eligible adjacent empty planet. Sources: [SCPT 264, 435.58–475.96s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/264-super-xxcha-kingdom-guide/)
- [Ggrocuto Rinn](components.md#leader-xxchaagent) **synergizes-with** [Xxekir Grom](components.md#leader-xxchahero). The agent can ready a planet so Xxcha may make another qualifying spend with the hero, if timing and planet availability allow. Sources: [SCPT 264, 866.86–885.68s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/264-super-xxcha-kingdom-guide/)
- [Diplomacy](components.md#strategy-card-pok2diplomacy) **synergizes-with** [Xxekir Grom](components.md#leader-xxchahero). Diplomacy refreshes planets; the hero increases their combined value when exhausted for qualifying spends. Sources: [SCPT 264, 1965.54–2067.58s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/264-super-xxcha-kingdom-guide/)
- [Xxekir Grom](components.md#leader-xxchahero) **synergizes-with** [Elder Qanoj](components.md#leader-xxchacommander). The hero improves vote spends and the commander adds a vote per planet, as the source interprets their combined agenda-phase impact; unlock requirements remain separate. Sources: [SCPT 264, 940.98–974.40s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/264-super-xxcha-kingdom-guide/); [SCPT 264, 1182.38–1217.76s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/264-super-xxcha-kingdom-guide/)
- [AI Development Algorithm](components.md#technology-aida) **enables** [War Sun](components.md#technology-ws). The proposed route uses AI Development Algorithm as an entry toward later technology choices including War Suns; a red skip can change the sequence. Sources: [SCPT 264, 3237.56–3322.24s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/264-super-xxcha-kingdom-guide/)
- [War Sun](components.md#technology-ws) **synergizes-with** [Xxekir Grom](components.md#leader-xxchahero). War Suns are an expensive way to convert the late economy described by the hero into military reach, if Xxcha survives to build them. Sources: [SCPT 264, 3154.10–3216.90s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/264-super-xxcha-kingdom-guide/)
- [Cruiser II](components.md#technology-cr2) **enables** [War Sun](components.md#technology-ws). Cruiser II can provide movement and point denial as a stopgap while the War Sun plan is still developing. Sources: [SCPT 264, 3395.48–3505.54s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/264-super-xxcha-kingdom-guide/)
- [PDS II](components.md#technology-pds2) **synergizes-with** [Loncara Ssodu](components.md#unit-xxcha-flagship). The guide describes PDS II and the flagship together as a deterrent when Xxcha has the investment and geography to support it. Sources: [SCPT 264, 3511.08–3545.80s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/264-super-xxcha-kingdom-guide/)
- [Scanlink Drone Network](components.md#technology-sdn) **synergizes-with** [Xxekir Grom](components.md#leader-xxchahero). Scanlink can increase the chance of finding attachments that improve planet values for later hero spending; it is worthwhile only when exploration timing and draws justify the detour. Sources: [SCPT 264, 4356.12–4433.86s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/264-super-xxcha-kingdom-guide/)

## The Yin Brotherhood

[Integrated page](factions/yin.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/yin-strategy-summary.md)

- [Dannel of the Tenth](components.md#leader-yinhero) **synergizes-with** [Indoctrination](components.md#ability-indoctrination). - [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd) **synergizes-with** [Carrier II](components.md#unit-carrier2).
