## The Yssaril Tribes

[Integrated page](factions/yssaril.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/yssaril-strategy-summary.md)

- [Stall Tactics](components.md#ability-stall-tactics) **enables** [Blackshade Infiltrator](components.md#unit-yssaril-mech). Using Stall Tactics can trigger mech deployment on a controlled planet, if a mech remains available. Sources: [SCPT 358, 1018.73–1020.91s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/); [SCPT 358, 1043.53–1045.65s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/); [SCPT 358, 1480.45–1480.83s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/); [SCPT 358, 1502.71–1506.53s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/)
- [Bio-Stims](components.md#technology-bs) **enables** [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd). The green engine and later movement technology form the guide’s broad research plan, subject to economy and prerequisites. Sources: [SCPT 358, 2428.95–2434.81s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/); [SCPT 358, 2503.63–2508.67s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/); [SCPT 358, 3781.49–3788.15s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/); [SCPT 358, 3862.55–3868.35s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/)
- [Ssruu](components.md#leader-yssarilagent) **synergizes-with** [Carth of Golden Sands](components.md#leader-hacanagent). When both factions cooperate, copying Hacan’s agent can help produce a commodity refresh and negotiated split. Sources: [SCPT 358, 4379.23–4380.13s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/); [SCPT 358, 4553.87–4555.17s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/)
- [Transparasteel Plating](components.md#technology-tp) **conflicts-with** [Hyper Metabolism](components.md#technology-hm). The guide presents these as alternative early green technologies, chosen by economy and tactical need. Sources: [SCPT 358, 2322.23–2326.51s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/); [SCPT 358, 2428.95–2434.81s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/); [SCPT 358, 4073.13–4076.89s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/); [SCPT 358, 4177.97–4184.39s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/358-super-yssaril-tribes-guide/)

## The Council Keleres - Mentak

[Integrated page](factions/keleresm.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/keleresm-strategy-summary.md)

- [Executive Order](components.md#technology-executiveorder) **enables** [Keleres Rider](components.md#promissory-riderm). Each Executive Order resolution creates another agenda outcome on which Keleres Rider may be offered; payment and buyer cooperation are required. Sources: [SCPT 472, 3278.34–3288.26s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/)
- [Executive Order](components.md#technology-executiveorder) **synergizes-with** [Bio-Stims](components.md#technology-bs). Bio-Stims may refresh Executive Order for another use, increasing agenda opportunities when the timing and resources support it. Sources: [SCPT 472, 4704.62–4727.58s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/)
- [Agency Supply Network](components.md#technology-asn) **synergizes-with** [Sarween Tools](components.md#technology-st). Separate production resolutions can let Sarween Tools discount each build; value depends on available docks and resources. Sources: [SCPT 472, 4994.88–5025.50s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/)
- [Agency Supply Network](components.md#technology-asn) **enables** [The Council Keleres - Mentak](factions/keleresm.md). The guide treats multiple production sources as a route to reinforce Mecatol Rex and prepare a later Fracture push, if access and time permit. Sources: [SCPT 472, 4963.58–4971.42s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/)
- [The Council Keleres - Mentak](factions/keleresm.md) **counters** [The Mentak Coalition](factions/mentak.md). When Mentak is a separate faction in the game, Pillage can intercept Keleres trade goods; the Mentak home-system variant is unavailable if Mentak is already present. Sources: [SCPT 472, 1822.40–1834.08s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/); [SCPT 472, 1984.28–1994.28s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/); [SCPT 472, 9346.06–9400.70s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/)
- [The Council Keleres - Mentak](factions/keleresm.md) **conflicts-with** [The Council Keleres - Argent](factions/keleresa.md). These are distinct Council Keleres starting variants; choose the Argent configuration only when the corresponding Argent faction is unused, and its hero advice does not automatically transfer to the Mentak configuration. Sources: [SCPT 472, 1376.56–1415.12s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/); [SCPT 472, 1984.28–1994.28s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/)
- [The Council Keleres - Mentak](factions/keleresm.md) **conflicts-with** [The Council Keleres - Xxcha](factions/keleresx.md). These are distinct Council Keleres starting variants; Xxcha hero advice applies only if that start is chosen and Xxcha is unused. Sources: [SCPT 472, 1376.56–1415.12s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/); [SCPT 472, 6477.86–6516.10s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/)
- [Executive Order](components.md#technology-executiveorder) **synergizes-with** [The Council Keleres - Xxcha](factions/keleresx.md). Only the Xxcha Keleres variant has the cited additional-votes hero interaction; the Executive Order vote remains dependent on other players’ choices. Sources: [SCPT 472, 6477.86–6663.76s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/)
- [Fleet Logistics](components.md#technology-fl) **enables** [Executive Order](components.md#technology-executiveorder). When Fleet Logistics is available and an additional scoring action is possible, it can follow a component action such as Executive Order; this is a conditional late-game line. Sources: [SCPT 472, 5930.54–5947.44s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/)
- [Space Dock II](components.md#technology-sd2) **synergizes-with** [Agency Supply Network](components.md#technology-asn). Space Dock II can add a useful production source when Keleres’ current network lacks production, but it can be redundant once multiple docks and Custodia production saturate the available actions. Sources: [SCPT 472, 8552.74–8579.62s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/); [SCPT 472, 8600.14–8604.90s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/); [SCPT 472, 8612.04–8614.86s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/472-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-council-keleres/)

## The Argent Flight

[Integrated page](factions/argent.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/argent-strategy-summary.md)

- [Sarween Tools](components.md#technology-st) **enables** [Aerie Hololattice](components.md#technology-ah). Sarween is the normal yellow start; Hololattice Production 1 receives its production discount. Sources: [SCPT 289, 801.48–803.98s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 2158.72–2163.24s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 2163.24–2172.58s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/)
- [Plasma Scoring](components.md#technology-ps) **synergizes-with** [Trrakan Aun Zulok](components.md#leader-argentcommander). When both modifiers apply to a qualifying ability roll, the guide describes an especially threatening home PDS roll. Sources: [SCPT 289, 2879.26–2883.16s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 2883.51–2887.92s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 5438.70–5440.66s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/)
- [PDS II](components.md#technology-pds2) **synergizes-with** [Strike Wing Alpha II](components.md#technology-swa2). Together they provide the guide’s preferred deterrence and low-cost midgame fleet package; neither guarantees safety. Sources: [SCPT 289, 2854.68–2859.18s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 2868.46–2870.76s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 2870.76–2873.60s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/)
- [Mirik Aun Sissiri](components.md#leader-argenthero) **enables** [Fleet Logistics](components.md#technology-fl). Fleet Logistics can stage the fleet before hero movement, reducing the chance an opponent blocks an empty destination. Sources: [SCPT 289, 3254.34–3256.02s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 3273.06–3276.24s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 3311.34–3316.58s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 3316.58–3320.58s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 3334.22–3336.76s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/)
- [Alliance](components.md#promissory-color-an) **synergizes-with** [PDS II](components.md#technology-pds2). The guide says the proposed Jol-Nar alliance exchange makes Argent’s PDS network much stronger, while describing it as a political tradeoff. Sources: [SCPT 289, 4347.46–4354.60s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 4354.60–4358.72s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 4372.80–4375.30s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/); [SCPT 289, 4375.30–4378.26s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/289-super-argent-flight-guide/)

## The Vuil&#x27;raith Cabal

[Integrated page](factions/cabal.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/cabal-strategy-summary.md)

- [The Stillness of Stars](components.md#leader-cabalagent) **synergizes-with** [Vortex](components.md#technology-vtx). The speakers call Vortex and the agent the faction’s actual economic power; Vortex is target-dependent, while the agent resolves after another player replenishes commodities. Sources: [SCPT 302, 2346.48–2353.18s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 2353.18–2356.68s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 2374.78–2377.96s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1783.61–1787.77s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1787.77–1794.97s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1794.97–1799.87s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/)
- [Dimensional Tear I](components.md#unit-cabal-spacedock) **enables** [That Which Molds Flesh](components.md#leader-cabalcommander). The commander unlock requires Cabal units in three gravity rifts, and each Dimensional Tear is a gravity rift. Sources: [SCPT 302, 2017.94–2019.72s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 2019.72–2021.42s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/)
- [Amalgamation](components.md#ability-amalgamation) **conflicts-with** [Riftmeld](components.md#ability-riftmeld). Both use a captured unit of the matching type: Amalgamation pays it to produce without resources, while Riftmeld returns it to ignore upgrade prerequisites; the technology still costs resources. Sources: [SCPT 302, 1053.62–1056.82s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1056.82–1062.48s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1067.28–1071.68s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1071.68–1076.74s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1076.74–1082.72s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1082.72–1086.78s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/)
- [Crucible](components.md#promissory-crucible) **enables** [Dimensional Tear I](components.md#unit-cabal-spacedock). Crucible’s movement bonus can combine with a Dimensional Tear’s gravity-rift movement to extend a route. Sources: [SCPT 302, 1624.30–1630.86s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1630.86–1637.08s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1637.08–1641.32s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1655.76–1660.46s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1660.46–1667.88s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1667.88–1672.80s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1677.92–1683.94s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 1683.94–1688.32s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/)
- [Construction](components.md#strategy-card-pok4construction) **enables** [Dimensional Tear I](components.md#unit-cabal-spacedock). Construction gives the early second dock the hosts call a need, and they recommend taking the card round one if available. Sources: [SCPT 302, 3066.06–3067.80s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 3067.98–3068.88s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 3088.96–3095.76s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 3096.52–3103.14s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 3103.14–3108.84s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/); [SCPT 302, 3108.84–3114.24s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/302-super-vuil-raith-cabal-guide/)

## The Empyrean

[Integrated page](factions/empyrean.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/empyrean-strategy-summary.md)

- [Acamar](components.md#leader-empyreanagent) **synergizes-with** [Dark Energy Tap](components.md#technology-det). When Acamar&#x27;s command-token gain is used to offset an early frontier exploration, DET&#x27;s retreat remains a separate added benefit; do not overexplore just because one token is refunded. Sources: [SCPT 476, 4994.34–5018.28s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/476-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-empyrean/); [SCPT 476, 5037.60–5068.32s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/476-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-empyrean/)
- [Dark Pact](components.md#promissory-dark-pact) **enables** [Technology](components.md#strategy-card-pok7technology). A neighbor can receive Dark Pact, wash commodities, and delay the Technology primary until Empyrean has the money to follow; partner must agree and retain enough commodities. Sources: [SCPT 476, 2951.66–3007.54s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/476-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-empyrean/); [SCPT 476, 3034.86–3070.04s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/476-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-empyrean/)
- [Watcher](components.md#unit-empyrean-mech) **counters** [Parley](components.md#action-card-parley). When a Watcher is positioned in or adjacent to an opponent&#x27;s units, the mech can cancel that opponent&#x27;s Parley; moving or spending the mech sacrifices its continuing position. Sources: [SCPT 476, 2529.64–2557.32s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/476-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-empyrean/); [SCPT 476, 2731.18–2737.94s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/476-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-empyrean/)
- [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd) **synergizes-with** [Carrier II](components.md#unit-carrier2). The source&#x27;s round-one double-tech example is conditional on enough resources and a reachable early control objective; with only starting carriers, double-tech may leave too little fleet to capitalize. Sources: [SCPT 476, 7665.68–7713.60s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/476-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-empyrean/); [SCPT 476, 7836.80–7848.02s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/476-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-empyrean/)
- [Light/Wave Deflector](components.md#technology-lwd) **synergizes-with** [Carrier II](components.md#unit-carrier2). Light/Wave Deflector plus Carrier II supports a surprise, high-capacity route to Styx or another blocked target when a late push can score; usefulness depends on map and timing. Sources: [SCPT 476, 7882.36–7903.64s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/476-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-empyrean/); [SCPT 476, 8044.80–8058.24s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/476-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-empyrean/)

## The Mahact Gene-Sorcerers

[Integrated page](factions/mahact.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/mahact-strategy-summary.md)

- [Bio-Stims](components.md#technology-bs) **synergizes-with** [The Mahact Gene-Sorcerers](factions/mahact.md). Bio-Stims enables recurring use of valuable tech specialties or technologies. Sources: [SCPT 467, 1649.80–1656.20s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 1656.20–1664.08s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/)
- [Edict](components.md#ability-edict) **enables** [Il Na Viroset](components.md#leader-mahactcommander). Edict can add opponents’ tokens to the fleet pool, helping unlock the commander. Sources: [SCPT 467, 2053.76–2055.30s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 2055.30–2065.22s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 2093.80–2101.64s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 4472.62–4477.72s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 4487.46–4492.48s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/)
- [Imperia](components.md#ability-imperia) **requires** [Il Na Viroset](components.md#leader-mahactcommander). Imperia uses an unlocked commander belonging to a player whose token is in the fleet pool. Sources: [SCPT 467, 2090.30–2092.76s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 2093.80–2101.64s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 2132.18–2136.10s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/)
- [Fleet Logistics](components.md#technology-fl) **synergizes-with** [Il Na Viroset](components.md#leader-mahactcommander). Fleet Logistics can precede the commander’s turn-ending activation. Sources: [SCPT 467, 4677.28–4682.18s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 4739.52–4744.46s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 4744.46–4748.26s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 4748.26–4753.40s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/)
- [Starlancer](components.md#unit-mahact-mech) **synergizes-with** [Edict](components.md#ability-edict). Starlancer spends a represented opponent token; Edict can reacquire it in a later win. Sources: [SCPT 467, 2055.30–2065.22s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 2660.16–2664.02s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 2732.40–2736.28s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/)
- [Airo Shir Aur](components.md#leader-mahacthero) **synergizes-with** [Il Na Viroset](components.md#leader-mahactcommander). Benediction can set a scoring or blocking fight while the commander supports repeated activations. Sources: [SCPT 467, 4977.22–4983.32s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 5038.60–5044.28s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 5144.00–5153.54s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 5166.08–5173.16s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/)
- [X-89 Bacterial Weapon Ω](components.md#technology-x89) **synergizes-with** [The Mahact Gene-Sorcerers](factions/mahact.md). The guide values X-89 as access to an answer for ground combat that fleet repositioning cannot solve. Sources: [SCPT 467, 7042.04–7048.86s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 7048.86–7053.60s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 7062.70–7068.30s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/); [SCPT 467, 7086.34–7091.78s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/467-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-mahact-gene-sorcerers/)

## The Nomad

[Integrated page](factions/nomad.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/nomad-strategy-summary.md)

- [Quantum Manipulator](components.md#unit-nomad-mech) **enables** [Memoria I](components.md#unit-nomad-flagship). Nomad&#x27;s flagship treats systems containing its mechs as adjacent under the guide&#x27;s description; this creates additional routes when the board and movement allow. Sources: [SCPT 309, 1020.72–1077.34s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/309-super-nomad-guide/)
- [Field Marshal Mercer](components.md#leader-nomadagentmercer) **enables** [Quantum Manipulator](components.md#unit-nomad-mech). Mercer can move a mech already on the board to a controlled planet in the active system at turn end, establishing a forward position for later routes. Sources: [SCPT 309, 1322.14–1408.30s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/309-super-nomad-guide/)
- [Future Sight](components.md#ability-future-sight) **synergizes-with** [Artuno the Betrayer](components.md#leader-nomadagentartuno). A Future Sight trade good gained from the supply can be banked on Artuno, but it is delayed until the agent readies. Sources: [SCPT 309, 1413.18–1503.78s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/309-super-nomad-guide/)
- [Trade](components.md#strategy-card-pok5trade) **synergizes-with** [Artuno the Betrayer](components.md#leader-nomadagentartuno). Trade&#x27;s primary supply trade goods can be banked by Artuno; this does not apply to trade goods already on another strategy card. Sources: [SCPT 309, 1483.28–1539.94s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/309-super-nomad-guide/)
- [Scuttle](components.md#action-card-scuttle) **synergizes-with** [Artuno the Betrayer](components.md#leader-nomadagentartuno). The speakers cite Scuttle on the flagship and a Dreadnought as an extreme 24-trade-good Artuno interaction when the components are available. Sources: [SCPT 309, 1540.66–1565.98s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/309-super-nomad-guide/)
- [Navarch Feng](components.md#leader-nomadcommander) **enables** [Memoria I](components.md#unit-nomad-flagship). After the commander unlocks, Nomad can produce its flagship without spending resources; the unit retains its printed value for effects that check unit cost/value. Sources: [SCPT 309, 1572.96–1609.78s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/309-super-nomad-guide/); [SCPT 309, 1695.08–1742.92s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/309-super-nomad-guide/)
- [Sling Relay](components.md#technology-sr) **synergizes-with** [Bio-Stims](components.md#technology-bs). Bio-Stims can ready Sling Relay for another use in a round when its extra production is useful. Sources: [SCPT 309, 4077.38–4086.62s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/309-super-nomad-guide/)
- [Fleet Logistics](components.md#technology-fl) **enables** [Ahk-Syl Siven](components.md#leader-nomadhero). Fleet Logistics can support two activations in sequence during a parade plan, provided the objective and action economy make the sequence useful. Sources: [SCPT 309, 4275.46–4301.74s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/309-super-nomad-guide/)
- [The Cavalry](components.md#promissory-cavalry) **enables** [Memoria I](components.md#unit-nomad-flagship). Cavalry temporarily gives one non-fighter ship the Nomad flagship&#x27;s combat, sustain, and anti-fighter-barrage values in a space combat against a player other than Nomad. Sources: [SCPT 309, 2298.66–2330.78s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/309-super-nomad-guide/)
- [Carrier II](components.md#unit-carrier2) **enables** [Quantum Manipulator](components.md#unit-nomad-mech). The guide recommends Carrier II to carry enough ground forces to overwhelm planets because Nomad has few ground-combat bonuses. Sources: [SCPT 309, 3914.38–3952.06s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/309-super-nomad-guide/)

## The Naaz-Rokha Alliance

[Integrated page](factions/naaz.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/naaz-strategy-summary.md)

- [Eidolon](components.md#unit-naaz-mech) **enables** [Distant Suns](components.md#ability-distant-suns). A mech on the explored planet enables the faction’s extra-card selection, the core exploration interaction described by the hosts. Sources: [SCPT 287, 733.68–754.76s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/287-super-naaz-rokha-alliance-guide/)
- [Garv and Gunn](components.md#leader-naazagent) **synergizes-with** [Distant Suns](components.md#ability-distant-suns). The agent can provide another eligible exploration which benefits from a mech on that planet. Sources: [SCPT 287, 1528.38–1556.26s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/287-super-naaz-rokha-alliance-guide/)
- [Dart and Tai](components.md#leader-naazcommander) **enables** [Pre-Fab Arcologies](components.md#technology-pfa). Exploring after gaining control of an enemy planet creates a possible refresh opportunity for the late Pre-Fab Arcologies plan. Sources: [SCPT 287, 1559.94–1605.60s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/287-super-naaz-rokha-alliance-guide/); [SCPT 287, 1883.18–1937.24s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/287-super-naaz-rokha-alliance-guide/)
- [Eidolon](components.md#unit-naaz-mech) **synergizes-with** [Visz El Vir](components.md#unit-naaz-flagship). The flagship adds a combat die to mechs in its system, so placement and movement determine where the bonus applies. Sources: [SCPT 287, 1332.94–1386.62s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/287-super-naaz-rokha-alliance-guide/)
- [Assault Cannon](components.md#technology-asc) **synergizes-with** [Z-Grav Eidolon](components.md#unit-naaz-mech-space). The hosts describe the mech as a ship at space-combat start, creating an Assault Cannon surprise opportunity. Sources: [SCPT 287, 1227.26–1279.66s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/287-super-naaz-rokha-alliance-guide/); [SCPT 287, 3913.52–3935.20s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/287-super-naaz-rokha-alliance-guide/)
- [Transit Diodes](components.md#technology-td) **synergizes-with** [Eidolon](components.md#unit-naaz-mech). Transit Diodes can regroup mechs dispersed to support exploration for a later defensive or offensive pivot. Sources: [SCPT 287, 3600.00–3658.70s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/287-super-naaz-rokha-alliance-guide/); [SCPT 287, 6381.52–6457.52s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/287-super-naaz-rokha-alliance-guide/)
- [Scanlink Drone Network](components.md#technology-sdn) **synergizes-with** [Pre-Fab Arcologies](components.md#technology-pfa). Repeated exploration can help refresh planets that make Pre-Fab Arcologies attractive, if the player can spend the income. Sources: [SCPT 287, 1883.18–1965.54s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/287-super-naaz-rokha-alliance-guide/); [SCPT 287, 3486.48–3505.72s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/287-super-naaz-rokha-alliance-guide/)

## The Titans of Ul

[Integrated page](factions/titans.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/titans-strategy-summary.md)

- [Terragenesis](components.md#ability-terragenesis) **requires** [Awaken](components.md#ability-awaken). The token placement from Terragenesis must occur on a prior action if Awaken is to redeem that sleeper; it cannot be created and redeemed during the same activation. Sources: [SCPT 458, 2022.10–2100.32s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/458-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-titans-of-ul/)
- [Coalescence](components.md#ability-coalescence) **enables** [Hel-Titan I](components.md#unit-titans-pds). A sleeper can remain dormant as a threat and be converted to a Hel-Titan when later awakened into a contested location, subject to combat. Sources: [SCPT 458, 2172.88–2204.40s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/458-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-titans-of-ul/)
- [Saturn Engine II](components.md#unit-titans-cruiser2) **scores** [Push Boundaries](components.md#public-objective-push-boundaries). Cruiser mobility and capacity can help Titans control enough planets; breakthrough coexistence is a separate conditional scoring avenue. Sources: [SCPT 458, 5710.60–5726.12s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/458-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-titans-of-ul/)
- [Hel-Titan I](components.md#unit-titans-pds) **enables** [Hecatoncheires](components.md#unit-titans-mech). When placing a PDS on a planet with a mech available in reinforcements, the described deploy ability may substitute a mech and infantry. Sources: [SCPT 458, 2981.38–3057.88s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/458-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-titans-of-ul/)
- [Saturn Engine II](components.md#unit-titans-cruiser2) **synergizes-with** [X-89 Bacterial Weapon Ω](components.md#technology-x89). Cheap mobile cruiser fleets project force, while X-89 is proposed as a way to overcome opponents&#x27; greater ground-unit volume; this is a strategic complement, not a rules dependency. Sources: [SCPT 458, 8231.71–8315.41s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/458-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-titans-of-ul/)
- [Ul the Progenitor](components.md#leader-titanshero) **enables** [Saturn Engine II](components.md#unit-titans-cruiser2). The speakers recommend using the refreshed Elysium values for influence when tokens are the constraint, preserving resources for economical cruiser builds. Sources: [SCPT 458, 5452.74–5527.50s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/458-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-titans-of-ul/)
- [Hel-Titan I](components.md#unit-titans-pds) **scores** [Build Defenses](components.md#public-objective-build-defenses). Scattered Hel-Titans can make structure objectives easier to prepare for and score, subject to the objective&#x27;s actual requirements. Sources: [SCPT 458, 6170.16–6216.96s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/458-the-ultimate-guide-to-the-titans-of-ul/)

## Last Bastion

[Integrated page](factions/bastion.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/bastion-strategy-summary.md)

- [Liberate](components.md#ability-liberate) **synergizes-with** [Integrated Economy](components.md#technology-ie). The guide’s conditional line needs the relevant prerequisites, a timely Technology primary, and a planet that can be readied before the follow-on production; it is not a default build path. Sources: [SCPT 441, 1995.62–2062.00s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/441-last-bastion-beginners-guide/); [SCPT 441, 5742.73–5813.91s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/441-last-bastion-beginners-guide/)
- [Phoenix Standard](components.md#ability-phoenixstandard) **enables** [Galvanize](components.md#ability-galvanize). At the end of combat, Phoenix Standard is described as one route to galvanizing a surviving participating unit; it does not require a win. Sources: [SCPT 441, 2073.52–2169.29s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/441-last-bastion-beginners-guide/)
- [Galvanize](components.md#ability-galvanize) **synergizes-with** [Proxima Targeting VI](components.md#technology-proxima). The speakers connect concentrated galvanized units with Proxima’s long ground-defense use case; the tech is situational and the X-89 interaction remains unresolved. Sources: [SCPT 441, 3287.56–3499.39s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/441-last-bastion-beginners-guide/)
- [A3 Valiance](components.md#unit-bastion-mech) **synergizes-with** [Lyra Keen](components.md#leader-bastionhero). The hosts speculate that losing a galvanized mech can set up the hero’s destruction effect in the same system; target and combat-value details are not resolved. Sources: [SCPT 441, 3016.01–3061.90s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/441-last-bastion-beginners-guide/); [SCPT 441, 4375.48–4458.04s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/441-last-bastion-beginners-guide/)

## The Deepwrought Scholarate

[Integrated page](factions/deepwrought.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/deepwrought-strategy-summary.md)

- [Oceanbound](components.md#ability-oceanbound) **synergizes-with** [Hydrothermal Mining](components.md#technology-hydrothermal). As coexistence places ocean cards in play, Hydrothermal Mining&#x27;s status-phase income grows; this matters most once several cards are active. Sources: [SCPT 445, 3124.08–3218.30s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/445-deepwrought-scholarate-beginners-guide/)
- [Share Knowledge](components.md#promissory-shareknowledge) **enables** [Gravity Drive](components.md#technology-gd). The note can temporarily lend a non-unit-upgrade technology such as Gravity Drive when a buyer needs it for a timing or movement plan; sell only when the exchange benefits the faction. Sources: [SCPT 445, 2824.34–2923.98s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/445-deepwrought-scholarate-beginners-guide/)
- [Doctor Carrina](components.md#leader-deepwroughtagent) **enables** [Oceanbound](components.md#ability-oceanbound). The agent&#x27;s placement can begin a coexistence and add an ocean card, supporting the commander&#x27;s stated unlock condition; choose placement for useful neighbors/objectives. Sources: [SCPT 445, 3806.22–3896.62s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/445-deepwrought-scholarate-beginners-guide/)
- [Eanautic](components.md#unit-deepwrought-mech) **synergizes-with** [Integrated Economy](components.md#technology-ie). The speakers describe using Integrated Economy and the mech&#x27;s production to build cardboard and then produce additional ships near the front. Sources: [SCPT 445, 2510.36–2602.78s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/445-deepwrought-scholarate-beginners-guide/)
- [Ta Zern](components.md#leader-deepwroughthero) **counters** [Fleet Logistics](components.md#technology-fl). When another player is close to winning and Deepwrought does not need Fleet Logistics for its own plan, the hero can purge it as a denial choice; weigh the cost to yourself. Sources: [SCPT 445, 4470.64–4535.34s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/445-deepwrought-scholarate-beginners-guide/)
- [D.W.S. Luminous](components.md#unit-deepwrought-flagship) **synergizes-with** [Research Team](components.md#ability-researchteam). A network of coexistence positions can extend the flagship&#x27;s movement and create staging routes; the route requires setup and does not guarantee passage to every target. Sources: [SCPT 445, 2400.00–2492.32s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/445-deepwrought-scholarate-beginners-guide/)

## The Firmament

[Integrated page](factions/firmament.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/firmament-strategy-summary.md)

- [Marionettes](components.md#ability-marionettes) **synergizes-with** [The Emirates of Hacan](factions/hacan.md). Siphon is placed while Firmament; its commodity return matters after the plot is active when Hacan gains commodities. Sources: [SCPT 449, 2165.78–2298.68s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/449-the-firmamentobsidian-beginners-guide/)
- [Planesplitter (Firmament)](components.md#technology-planesplitter-firm) **enables** [Planesplitter (Obsidian)](components.md#technology-planesplitter-obs). Gain the fracture-opening Firmament side before flipping; the Obsidian side is available after transition and cannot be researched. Sources: [SCPT 449, 4187.94–4250.46s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/449-the-firmamentobsidian-beginners-guide/)
- [Viper EX-23](components.md#unit-firmament-mech) **synergizes-with** [Imperial](components.md#strategy-card-pok8imperial). Only in the narrow offensive example: take a planet as Firmament, flip for control, then use Imperial if scoring timing permits. Sources: [SCPT 449, 3268.06–3329.48s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/449-the-firmamentobsidian-beginners-guide/)

## The Crimson Rebellion

[Integrated page](factions/crimson.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/crimson-strategy-summary.md)

- [Exile I](components.md#unit-crimson-destroyer) **enables** [Incursion](components.md#ability-incursion). Exile remains in the qualifying system through the end-of-combat window; the destroyer must survive its own combat. Sources: [SCPT 430, 1828.96–1890.20s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/430-crimson-rebellion-beginners-guide/)
- [Dark Energy Tap](components.md#technology-det) **synergizes-with** [Exile I](components.md#unit-crimson-destroyer). Destroyers explore empty systems while establishing breach access; value depends on available frontier targets. Sources: [SCPT 430, 1828.96–1890.20s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/430-crimson-rebellion-beginners-guide/)
- [Exile II](components.md#technology-exile2) **enables** [Incursion](components.md#ability-incursion). Upgrade extends the breach placement reach; active/inactive side choice depends on destination and route. Sources: [SCPT 430, 1908.10–2048.16s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/430-crimson-rebellion-beginners-guide/)
- [Quietus](components.md#unit-crimson-flagship) **synergizes-with** [Incursion](components.md#ability-incursion). Quietus suppresses abilities only while it is in a system with an active breach. Sources: [SCPT 430, 2520.68–2657.68s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/430-crimson-rebellion-beginners-guide/)
- [Ahk Ravin](components.md#leader-crimsonagent) **enables** [Carrier I](components.md#unit-carrier). Swap can redeploy a carrier and its carried units; preserve enough ships and planetary defense. Sources: [SCPT 430, 3423.28–3567.48s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/430-crimson-rebellion-beginners-guide/)
- [Revenant](components.md#unit-crimson-mech) **enables** [Incursion](components.md#ability-incursion). A tactical action and active breach are required to commit a mech remotely. Sources: [SCPT 430, 2965.14–3066.56s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/430-crimson-rebellion-beginners-guide/)
- [Sling Relay](components.md#technology-sr) **enables** [Carrier I](components.md#unit-carrier). Sling Relay can build and reposition an additional carrier when the primary or resources support it. Sources: [SCPT 430, 6005.34–6117.00s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/430-crimson-rebellion-beginners-guide/)
- [Incursion](components.md#ability-incursion) **enables** [Imperial](components.md#strategy-card-pok8imperial). A prepared breach route and the required Mecatol presence make the Imperial play available; scoring still depends on the objective and timing. Sources: [SCPT 430, 6251.80–6269.50s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/430-crimson-rebellion-beginners-guide/)

## The Ral Nel Consortium

[Integrated page](factions/ralnel.md) · [Readable guide](summaries/ralnel-strategy-summary.md)

- [Nanomachines](components.md#technology-nanomachines) **enables** [Miniaturization](components.md#ability-miniaturization). Nanomachines places PDS and Miniaturization can later transport structures to controlled planets; this is a placement line, not a guaranteed score. Sources: [SCPT 434, 3273.88–3358.80s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/434-ral-nel-consortium-beginners-guide/)
- [Linkship I](components.md#unit-ralnel-destroyer) **synergizes-with** [PDS I](components.md#unit-pds). A transported PDS can provide its space-cannon ability to a Linkship in the same system under the episode’s current interpretation. Sources: [SCPT 434, 2876.14–2925.96s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/434-ral-nel-consortium-beginners-guide/)
- [Linkship II](components.md#technology-linkship2) **conflicts-with** [PDS II](components.md#technology-pds2). The hosts reject transferring PDS II adjacent-system range through Linkship II; this debated interaction would change faction strategy materially. Sources: [SCPT 434, 2939.20–2995.28s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/434-ral-nel-consortium-beginners-guide/)
- [The Ral Nel Consortium](factions/ralnel.md) **enables** [Kan Kip Rel](components.md#leader-ralnelagent). The agent supplies a flexible action card and stall that can support deal-making and action-card plans. Sources: [SCPT 434, 4182.22–4226.76s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/434-ral-nel-consortium-beginners-guide/)
- [The Ral Nel Consortium](factions/ralnel.md) **synergizes-with** [Nano-Link Permit](components.md#promissory-nanolink). A buyer can move an adjacent dock into the active system and, under the hosts’ timing explanation, build from it after activation. Sources: [SCPT 434, 3781.14–3812.08s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/434-ral-nel-consortium-beginners-guide/)
- [Director Nel](components.md#leader-ralnelhero) **enables** [The Ral Nel Consortium](factions/ralnel.md). Signal Intrusion conditionally reopens the action phase after passing for tokens and a card, potentially creating a late objective window. Sources: [SCPT 434, 4693.36–4795.70s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/434-ral-nel-consortium-beginners-guide/)
- [Alarum](components.md#unit-ralnel-mech) **scores** [The Ral Nel Consortium](factions/ralnel.md). Adjacent-system ground forces may be pulled to an Alarum’s planet after combat, potentially helping a control objective when forces are nearby. Sources: [SCPT 434, 3560.28–3665.76s](https://spacecatspeaceturtles.podbean.com/e/434-ral-nel-consortium-beginners-guide/)
